referenceFunction.generalComment: Disposal of a silencer for a air handling unit with 1800 m3/h nominal air flow rate (at 2 m/s air speed in cross section of air filter or heat exchanger) kg/(m3/h), total weight: 0.05 kg/(m3/h), including a frame construction, casing, silencer baffle with section length 900mm. The frame construction made of aluminium-profiles, casing made of hot-dip galvanized and powder coated steel sheets insulated with polyurethane foam, rock wool as sound-absorbing media.
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: Transport to dismantling facilities, machines for handling in sorting plant, electricity demand for sorting plant, final disposal of waste material. Cut-off to recycling for metals.

technology.text: Disposal to a sorting plant assumed. Metal pieces, copper in cables and electronic devices are recycled, plastic parts are incinerated, inert wastes (e.g. rock wool) are landfilled.
